goal: Prevent node state corruption when saving block or undo files to disk fails
Stops metadata and coins cache from advancing when underlying block data is not durable
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by testing with injected flush failures locally (arejula27, optout21)
Notes it prevents corruption especially when block data is stored on a separate disk (mzumsande)
Resolved concern about potential side effects of skipping timer updates on early exit (optout21)

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it prevents chainstate database corruption when block or undo file flushes fail
Stops block index metadata and UTXO records from being treated as durable when block data is missing
